Article Title: BJP wins but independents rewrite Rajasthan civic poll math
Article Text:
CM Bhajan Lal Sharma, BJP state president Madan Rathore and senior party functionaries celebrate at BJP headquarters in Jaipur Monday

Rajasthan civic poll

Rajasthan Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma, BJP state President Madan Rathore and other leaders celebrate after the party's victory in the state local body elections at the BJP headquarter in Jaipur on 14 September 2026.





JAIPUR: Independents emerged as the decisive force in Rajasthan’s urban local body elections, limiting BJP ’s gains and keeping Congress competitive across several towns.BJP finished as the single largest party, but the scale of independent victories turned many civic bodies into arenas for post-poll negotiation rather than clear mandates.According to final figures uploaded on the State Election Commission website, results had been declared in 10,235 of 10,244 wards by late Monday, with BJP winning 4,179, Congress 3,613 and independents picking up 2,273 to collectively take third position and establish themselves as potential kingmakers in urban local bodies where neither major party managed to cross the majority mark.At the urban local body level, BJP secured majorities in four municipal corporations – Jaipur, Bhilwara, Kota and Udaipur – and emerged as the single largest party in Alwar. Of the 47 municipal councils, BJP won a clear majority in 11, Congress in six and independents or others in four. In Fatehpur, Congress was tied with an independent candidate.The results give BJP the numerical edge, but not the sweep it sought in the first major statewide urban electoral test for the Bhajan Lal Sharma govt since it came to power in Dec 2023. Sharma campaigned extensively, holding roadshows in Ajmer, Bhilwara, Udaipur, Pali, Bikaner, Bharatpur, Jaipur, Alwar, Jodhpur and Kota.Even so, the party suffered reverses in key pockets and fell short in several prestige contests.The sharpest setbacks came from politically symbolic terrain.Jhalawar and Baran, former chief minister Vasundhara Raje’s strongholds for four decades, slipped out of BJP’s control. Congress won Jhalawar, while AAP made its political debut in the state by claiming control of its maiden municipal body in Baran.Sharma also faced a difficult verdict in his home turf of Bharatpur despite his direct role in candidate selection. Independents won 36 wards there, compared with 20 for BJP and seven for Congress, leaving the ruling party far from a majority.Pali delivered another blow. BJP lost the city to Congress despite its association with BJP state president Madan Rathore, cabinet minister Joraram Kumawat and former Union minister PP Choudhary.The party also suffered setbacks in parts of Shekhawati and eastern Rajasthan. Its performance in Bikaner and Ajmer, where Congress ended BJP’s 36-year hold over the city, has sharpened concerns within the organisation, particularly with panchayat polls likely later this year.Congress, though behind BJP in the overall tally, gained enough ground to make the point that BJP’s urban dominance remained incomplete. State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra delivered a strong result for the party in his home turf of Sikar and Laxmangarh, strengthening his position within the state unit.In Tonk, Congress managed an edge in Sachin Pilot’s political turf even though the former deputy chief minister largely stayed away from campaigning and ticket distribution. The party also mounted a serious challenge in Jodhpur, former chief minister Ashok Gehlot’s political base, where Union minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat campaigned extensively over the past month.The CPM also entered the winners’ list by commanding enough numbers to form the board in Nokha, Bikaner.The strongest signal from the verdict is the independent vote. With 2,273 wards, independents are set to influence control in several bodies where neither BJP nor Congress has a clear majority. Their performance points to the continuing strength of local networks, candidate reputation and ward-level grievances over party loyalty in many towns.The State Election Commission Monday postponed, until further orders, elections for chairperson and deputy chairperson in four urban local bodies after technical glitches in EVMs delayed the declaration of results. The affected bodies include Jaipur, Jodhpur and Kota municipal corporations, and Suket municipality in Kota. During counting, results from some booths could not be released due to EVM malfunctions, leaving the results in these bodies incomplete. The Commission said fresh dates would be announced later.The SEC has ordered repolling at 10 polling stations in Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota and Suket. Repolling will be held on Sept 16 from 7am to 6pm, with counting on Sept 17 from 8am at designated centres.The affected booths include five in Jaipur Municipal Corporation, one in Jodhpur Municipal Corporation, three in Kota Municipal Corporation and one in Suket municipality. The Commission said the number of votes affected by the malfunction exceeded the victory margins between the nearest rival candidates, requiring repolling.In Jaipur, BJP crossed the majority mark with 78 seats in the 150-member Jaipur Municipal Corporation. Results of four wards were withheld after EVMs developed technical snags, leaving counting incomplete.Elections were held in two phases, on Sept 9 and 11, across 309 urban local bodies — 10 municipal corporations, 47 municipal councils and 252 municipalities. The increase in the number of bodies since the previous elections followed the creation of new municipalities, expansion and reorganisation of existing urban areas, and delimitation.The results mark a shift from the map that emerged after the previous municipal elections, held between Nov 2019 and Feb 2021, when Rajasthan had 196 urban local bodies with 7,500 wards. After the election of mayors and chairpersons, Congress controlled 123 bodies, BJP 64, and Independents and other parties nine.
Article Summary: BJP finished as the single largest party, but scale of independent victories turned many civic bodies into arenas for post-poll negotiation. Results had been declared in 10,235 of 10,244 wards by late Monday. BJP won a clear majority in 11, Congress in six and independents or others in four.

Article Title: ‘Ignored at first, only males in car’: Gurgaon biker says driver repeatedly came close before crash
Article Text:
In a fresh video statement, Sia said she had not initially noticed the car following her.

‘I was shaking and couldn’t ride’

(With inputs from ANI)





GURGAON: Woman biker Sia said she initially tried to ignore the car that later crashed into her on Golf Course Road, but became scared after the driver repeatedly came close to her bike and gestured for her to stop.In a fresh video statement, Sia said she had not initially noticed the car following her. She said the first indication that something was wrong came when it sped past her very closely, startling her.“I tried to ignore it at first. Then, the car slowed down and dropped back behind me,” she said.Sia claimed the car later pulled up alongside her, with the driver making gestures and trying to get her to stop. She said another man sitting next to the driver was also making gestures.“That’s when I got scared. You could clearly tell from his face that they had been drinking,” she said, adding that she could not see exactly how many people were inside because of the car’s tinted windows.Sia said she believed there were two more men in the back and added that, from what she could see, there were no women in the car.She said she signalled the driver to stay to the side and not come too close. When she sensed the vehicle veering towards her bike or trying to overtake, she accelerated slightly because she feared the driver might do something reckless.Meanwhile, a fellow rider tried to pull alongside her, she said, while another vehicle came between them, forcing her to slow down.Sia said her front-facing camera captured the car, which she claimed moved from the first lane to the third lane before hitting her. She said she fell from the bike and was left disoriented after the collision.She said another rider tried to stop the driver, but he insisted that the crash was not his fault and blamed her instead. According to Sia, the driver then jumped a red light, took a left turn and fled.Sia said the crash left both the front and rear brakes of her motorcycle broken, making it difficult to ride.The other riders helped her reach a biker’s cafe in Gurgaon, where she had been headed. One rider gave her a pillion seat, she said, while another later rode her damaged motorcycle.“I stayed for about an hour because I was absolutely terrified. I was literally shaking and couldn't ride my bike at all,” she said.Sia said she eventually rode another rider’s motorcycle before switching back to her own and taking it home.She also said a fellow biker who knew her from previous group rides had his camera running during the incident and recorded what happened.The crash video went viral on Monday. Accused driver Kalyan Baisla has denied deliberately hitting Sia and claimed that a group of bikers was riding aggressively, repeatedly overtaking and slowing down in front of his car.He said Sia suddenly turned while he was taking a U-turn and that he had little time to react.Baisla has also denied fleeing the scene and claimed that the videos circulating online were edited by joining separate clips.
Article Summary: In a fresh video statement, Sia said she had not initially noticed the car following her. She said the first indication that something was wrong came when it sped past her. Accused driver Kalyan Baisla has denied deliberately hitting Sia and claimed that a group of bikers was riding aggressively.

Article Title: 'I'm tired of this': Indian wushu player Divyanshi Choudhary breaks down on hostel roof after Asian Games axing
Article Text:
Divyanshi Choudhary (Image credit: Instagram)

Father questions last-minute decision

What Wushu body said

Federation explains Roshibina’s selection

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Indian wushu player Divyanshi Choudhary was looking forward to making her Asian Games debut in Nagoya. However, just days before the event, the 18-year-old was dropped from the Indian squad.Divyanshi had been sharing her excitement on social media as the Games approached. She posted pictures of her kit and also shared moments from the Indian team’s send-off ceremony in New Delhi.Her latest video, however, showed a very different side. Standing on the roof of her hostel at the National Institute of Sports in Patiala, Divyanshi was seen in tears as she spoke about being left out of the team.She said she was removed from the women’s 60kg category and replaced by Roshibina Devi Naorem, whom she had beaten in the selection trials.“I’m tired of this... I have been mentally harassed so much. Since June, July, they have been after me because she (Roshibina) wanted to go. Given that I beat her, why is it a problem for her now,” Divyanshi said in the video.“I beat her, it’s my right to go there (Japan). She has been knocking at different doors...it’s abuse of power,” she added.Divyanshi’s father, Sunil, said the family was informed about the decision only on Friday morning.He claimed that they were not given any reason for her removal.He also alleged that Divyanshi was supposed to be told about the decision only after reaching the airport, when she would have been informed that she was not travelling with the team.Sunil also questioned the decision to replace Divyanshi with Roshibina, a world medallist, two-time Asian medallist and Arjuna awardee.“Divyanshi beat Roshibina in the semifinals of the trials. If the association had to send someone, they should have sent the individual who Divyanshi beat in the final,” Sunil told Sportstar.ID@undefined Caption not available.ID@undefined Caption not available.ID@undefined Caption not available.The Wushu Association of India has rejected the allegations. Its president Jitender Bajwa said the federation was not responsible for removing Divyanshi from the squad.Bajwa said the Sports Authority of India (SAI) took the decision after an injury was discovered.“Divyanshi joined the national camp which was organised by SAI a month back. She was carrying a knee injury and was trying to hide it by avoiding training. When SAI eventually found out about this, the replaced her name,” Bajwa told Sportstar.Divyanshi’s father admitted that she had suffered an injury but said she was undergoing treatment.“After she got an injury, we got Divyanshi checked by a doctor. She had an injury to her ACL (Anterior Cruiciate ligament). The doctor said it could be treated by rehabilitation,” Sunil said.Bajwa said the coaches at the national camp noticed that Divyanshi was not training and recommended that she undergo a medical examination.“The coaches in the camp had recommended that Divyanshi be checked for an injury because she was not training. Eventually, the coaches informed SAI which arranged for a medical test which showed she was carrying a knee injury. They couldn’t carry an injured athlete to the Asian Games so they had to remove her name,” he said.Bajwa also explained why Roshibina was chosen despite losing to Divyanshi in the selection trials.He said Himanshi of Chandigarh, who lost in the final, had suffered a jaw fracture and was therefore unavailable as a replacement.“The losing finalist, Himanshi of Chandigarh, suffered a fracture to her jaw which is why her name was not included. Instead the coaches had already recommended the name of Roshibina Devi as the replacement player for Divyanshi,” Bajwa said.Bajwa said the federation was also disappointed that Divyanshi would miss the Asian Games.“She is a very talented athlete. She performed very well at the trials. It is bad luck that she will not be going to the Asian Games,” he said.
Article Summary: Divyanshi Choudhary was dropped from the Indian squad for the Asian Games. The 18-year-old was replaced by Roshibina Devi Naorem, whom she had beaten in the selection trials. Her father, Sunil, said the family was informed about the decision only on Friday.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge
Article Text:
El Rubius reacted honestly after his elimination from MrBeast’s $1 million challenge, calling it “unfair” and claiming he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings. His response felt real and balanced, especially after MrBeast’s team later sent him a cake, softening the moment.

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

El Rubius did not just walk away from MrBeast’s $1 million streamer challenge. He opened up. Soon after his elimination, the Spanish creator shared a raw reaction with fans, giving them a closer look at what the experience felt like from inside the game. It was not polished or carefully framed. It felt real, and that is exactly why it caught attention so quickly.The clip and his response have since fueled conversations across the streaming space. Some viewers believe intense competitions like this naturally lead to uneven situations. Others feel Rubius may have had a point about being singled out. Either way, his words have added a human layer to a challenge that many only saw as entertainment.Speaking through an Instagram Story, Rubius did not hide his frustration, but he also made sure to thank his supporters. He said, "Guys, I just got knocked out of the game. It was a bit of an unfair elimination, but hey, at least I managed to walk away with $50,000 for you all, which I’ve already distributed. It went to the mods, the subs, and the non-subs alike."He further added, "I’m happy, of course, though admittedly, it was incredibly tough.I wasn't really a fan of the challenge itself, either. But then again... it was basically a three-against-one situation the entire time. I mean, they were targeting me specifically the whole way through. I kept trying to go after RaKai, but, well, he actually just got eliminated in the end. So, at least justice was served for Abraham. Abraham, if you’re watching this, we were all rooting for you, and standing right there with you."His message carried mixed emotions. There was disappointment, yes, but also pride in how he handled things. Giving away his $50,000 winnings to his community stood out as a gesture that meant more than the result itself.He continued with another honest note, saying, "And in the end, karma finally caught up with that little punk. Sorry, I’m being a bit toxic right now, but let's just hope the MrBeast team doesn't see this! Guys, thank you all so much. Seriously, thank you for all the support and for just being there."He added, "Every time I asked for something in the chat or whatever it was, you guys were right there. You’re incredible. I’m a little disappointed in myself, personally, mostly for not performing better, but hey, I gave it my all, and we still walked away with $50,000, so we’ve got to look on the bright side. All right, guys, big hugs to all my brothers out there!"Interestingly, the story did not end with frustration. Later that day, Rubius revealed that MrBeast’s team had sent him a cake after his exit. It was a small gesture, but it shifted the mood. It showed that even in a high-pressure challenge, there is still room for respect.In the end, Rubius’ reaction felt honest and grounded. That is what stayed with people.
Article Summary: El Rubius was eliminated from MrBeast's $1 million streamer challenge. He called it "unfair" and said he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings.

Article Title: IPL craze costs techie Rs 1.46 lakh in fake RCB vs CSK ticket scam
Article Text:
Image credit: AI generated pic

RCB register their second win

NEW DELHI: IPL comes and the demand for tickets and passes go soaring up by the fans. The desperation to get inside the stadium to watch their favourite teams in action in the IPL go high and high. When the tickets get sold out, the demand gets too hig, and the cricket fans even ask for tickets in black. But for a 25-year-old techie the craze for IPL tickets for RCB vs CSK turned too costly and he was duped for a massive Rs. 1.46 lakh.The techie, a resident of B Narayanapura, fell into a trap by a post posted by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram.As per a report in Deccan Herald, the techie alleged in a complaint to Mahadevapura Police that an individual claiming to be Sumit Biswal promised he could arrange IPL tickets along with food coupons.As per the techie, Biswal was introduced him as a senior supervisor for ticket counter at M Chinnaswamy Stadium"He asked me to come near the stadium gate number 10, saying someone would deliver the tickets within minutes, and even sent an email confirmation to gain my trust," the complainant told Deccan Herald."Initially, I agreed to buy two tickets for Rs 3,700 each,but he kept asking for more money under various pretexts such as refundable security deposits, additional ID cards and food coupons.Trusting him, I made multiple payments - even using my mother’s bank account after exhausting my own limits—and ended up transferring around Rs 1.46 lakh," he added.Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s incisive spell of 3-41, coming after a marauding batting show from Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal, propelled Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to a commanding 43-run victory over Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in their IPL 2026 encounter at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday.The contest saw RCB’s batting unit dismantle CSK’s attack with relentless hitting, as David’s 70 not out off just 25 balls and Patidar’s unbeaten 48 off only 19 balls provided for the late fireworks after Padikkal’s fluent 50 off 29 balls had set the tone for the daunting total.Their combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026. In reply, CSK faltered under scoreboard pressure, with Sarfaraz Khan’s 50 off 24 balls and Prashant Veer’s 43 the lone acts of resistance amid a string of failures from the top order.Bhuvneshwar was at his disciplined best and even crossed the 200-mark in terms of wickets in IPL, with others also chipping in as CSK were bowled out for 207 in 19.4 overs. The comprehensive win also meant RCB have registered four consecutive triumphs over CSK for the first time in the IPL’s history.
Article Summary: A 25-year-old techie fell into a trap by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram. Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal's combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026.

Article Title: "Trans women are.....": Clavicular’s viral moment with trans women sparks fresh conversation on internet culture
Article Text:
A viral clip featuring Clavicular and trans women is gaining attention for its calm and honest tone. The conversation explores how online language and trends move across communities. Instead of conflict, the exchange highlights shared influence and mutual awareness. Viewers are engaging with its thoughtful nature, as it reflects how internet culture evolves through collaboration rather than ownership.

Clavicular and trans women share a surprising realization about online trends

The video of Clavicular, a short-video producer, is going around the Internet, yet not the reason why. There is no yelling or over-the-top drama. It is a mere, everyday talk that seems almost novel nowadays, in the age of internet, which is overflowing with content. The scene is easy-going, the tone of the narrative is straightforward, and the characters appear more concerned with conversation than combat.The message that is being addressed is the flow of the conversation. It discusses internet culture, the way people communicate with one another and the place of trends. Rather than bringing out a debate, the encounter towards curiosity. It quietly brings attention to something that a lot of people who use the internet notice but don't often say out loud. People in different communities often have a bigger impact on each other than they think.The conversation begins with a confident and lighthearted comment from one of the trans women present. She says, "You know that trans women are like the OG lip masters, right? We are very talented in the program. Like, I do the peptides, I'm on Zeta." Her tone carries a mix of pride and humor, setting a relaxed vibe at the table.Clavicular responds in a way that keeps the mood steady but adds a different angle.He says, "That is funny because you guys were using a lot of the words in like the South Korean subreddits in like 2014." It’s not confrontational. If anything, it feels like an observation. He points to how certain words and ideas may have traveled across different online spaces over time.Another voice joins in and brings the moment full circle. "Guys, we're like the OGs. I saw a couple of posts about that. We're like copying each other." That line hits in a simple but honest way. It reflects something familiar. Online culture is rarely created in isolation. It grows through sharing, borrowing, and sometimes even unknowingly repeating.That's what makes the clip so powerful. It doesn't want to make a point or win an argument. It only shows a group of people talking, listening, and figuring something out together.This moment feels different in a space where viral content often leads to fights. It reminds people that conversations can be calm, thoughtful, and still important. And sometimes, that honest silence is what makes it work.
Article Summary: A viral clip featuring Clavicular and trans women is gaining attention for its calm and honest tone. The conversation explores how online language and trends move across communities. Viewers are engaging with its thoughtful nature, as it reflects how internet culture evolves through collaboration.

Article Title: ‘Bhagne nahi dunga kisi ko’: Gangster Himanshu Bhau claims responsibility for Delhi gym trainer murder
Article Text:
The victim, Vijay Lohia of Fatehpur Beri, was shot dead after bike-borne assailants allegedly opened fire at him near Hansa Chowk





NEW DELHI: Gangster Himanshu Bhau has claimed responsibility for the murder of a 30-year-old gym trainer in south Delhi’s Fatehpur Beri, with police verifying the authenticity of the social media post attributed to the gangster and probing whether the claim is linked to the killing.In a later post, purportedly by Bhau, the gangster issued a warning in Hindi, saying, “Bhagne se kam nahi chalega field me aao. Bhagne nahi dunga kisi ko (Running away won't help, come out to the field. I won't let anyone run away).” The post mentioned “Bhau gang” and “Since-2020”, the post read.The victim, Vijay Lohia of Fatehpur Beri, was shot dead after bike-borne assailants allegedly opened fire at him near Hansa Chowk around 10am on Monday. Police suspect the attack may be linked to an old rivalry between two families that has already claimed two lives.No arrest has been made so far. Deputy commissioner of police (south) Anant Mittal said a team rushed to the spot after receiving information about the firing. “Several rounds were fired by two suspects, resulting in one person sustaining fatal injuries and subsequently succumbing,” he said.According to police, an FIR was registered under BNS Section 103 (murder) at Fatehpuri Beri police station against unknown persons.Raids are being conducted to trace the suspects and teams have been formed to arrest them, Mittal said.Sources said the assailants were waiting outside the gym for Vijay. While some sources said four men were involved, police said only two men carried out the attack. The suspects were wearing helmets and were riding two motorcycles that allegedly had fake numberplates, a source said. “It appears they had been conducting reconnaissance for the past few days,” the source added.Vijay was called outside the gym on the pretext that someone wanted to speak to him. He was ambushed as soon as he stepped out, with the assailants allegedly firing around 12-15 rounds. Vijay suffered multiple injuries, including at least two to the head. He was taken to a hospital, where he was declared dead.Vijay is survived by his wife, Ritu, 24.Police are also verifying the authenticity of the social media post attributed to Bhau, who is based abroad, and investigating whether the claim has any connection with the killing.
Article Summary: Gangster Himanshu Bhau has claimed responsibility for the murder of a 30-year- old gym trainer in south Delhi. Vijay Lohia of Fatehpur Beri was shot dead after bike-borne assailants allegedly opened fire at him near Hansa Chowk. Police suspect the attack may be linked to an old rivalry between two families that has already claimed two lives.

Article Title: DDA to host two-day World Tourism Day celebration at Baansera
Article Text:
New Delhi:

,





Delhi Development Authority (DDA) will organise a World Tourism Day celebration at Baansera, Sarai Kale Khan, on Sept 26 and 27, to showcase India’s rich diversity in tourism, art, craft, cuisine and music.The park will be divided into six themed zones. The first one will be Hunar Galiwhere traditional arts and crafts will be presented by artists. Pottery, block printing, bangle making, henna and mandala art would find a presence here. The zone is aimed at giving visitors an opportunity to see traditional crafts through interactive activities.The second zone will be Yaadon Ki Gali, whichwill take visitors down the memory lane through a vintage-themed experience featuring a photo booth, puppet show and bioscope.The third zone will be Bachpan Ki Dukaan, centred around childhood nostalgia.Another attraction, Chitthi Ghar, will offer visitors a postcard-writing and posting experience, bringing back the traditional practice of writing and sending postcards.“While older people will get to relive old memories, younger visitors will get to know about the traditional arts and crafts which are no longer practised,” said an official.Food will be a major component of the celebration. A section called Bharat Ke Zaayeke will showcase cuisines from at least 10-12 states or regions. “The zone will highlight the country’s regional culinary diversity and offer visitors an opportunity to sample different traditional food choices,” an official said.For children, Masti Ka Adda will feature rides and other recreational activities.“The six zones form an integral part of the visitor experience,” said an official. The tendering process has started to engage agencies.
Article Summary: World Tourism Day will be held in New Delhi on Sept 26 and 27. The event will showcase India’s rich diversity in tourism, art, craft, cuisine and music. The park will be divided into six themed zones. A section will showcase cuisines from at least 10-12 states or regions.

Article Title: LPG leak triggers blast at Sanpada snacks shop in Navi Mumbai, 2 injured
Article Text:
A LPG cylinder leakage caused a blast at a Sanpada snacks shop on Tuesday morning.





NAVI MUMBAI: Two men sustained severe burn injuries after a LPG cylinder leakage triggered a blast at a snacks shop on the ground floor of a society in sector-1, Sanpada on Tuesday morning. The impact of the blast was so severe that the glass facade of a hospital, located about 50 feet away, was shattered. Fortunately, the patients and staff at the hospital were not hurt.Purushottam Jadhav, Divisional officer of Vashi fire station said, "At 6.13 am, the Vashi fire station received the emergency call informing about a cylinder blast at a snacks shop in Pratik CHS on sector-1, Sanpada. The fire bridge team reached the spot within 5 minutes.It was found that the blast was due to leakage in one of the three LPG cylinders kept at snacks shop. The two men working at the snacks shop sustained severe burn injuries and were rushed to NMMC hospital, Vashi. Those injured were identified as Arjun Yadav (46) who has sustained 75 precent burn injuries and Manish Yadav (26), who has sustained 90 percent burns.The blast even caused damage to two shops adjacent to the snacks shop and three other shops in the neighbouring Abhimanyu CHS. While, the glass facade of Suraj hospital located opposite to Pratik CHS was shattered due to the impact of the blast."
Article Summary: Two men sustained severe burn injuries after a LPG cylinder leakage triggered a blast at a snacks shop on the ground floor of a society in Sanpada. The impact of the blast was so severe that the glass facade of a hospital, located about 50 feet away, was shattered. Fortunately, the patients and staff at the hospital were not hurt.

Article Title: Khalapur temple theft: Video shows masked man stealing silver Padukas; 2 arrested in Pune
Article Text:
he accused stole silver Charan Paduka from Shree Swami Samarth temple on September 2





NAVI MUMBAI: The Khalapur police probing the theft case wherein a masked man had decamped with a pair of silver toe-knob sandals (Charan Paduka) representing divine footprints offered at Shree Swami Samarth temple in Khalapur city on September 2, have arrested the acccused thief and his aide by tracking them to Pune on Monday.Pradeep Rayannavar, senior inspector of Khalapur informed that, the arrested accused are Mahendrasingh Rathod, 45, who hails from Rajasthan and Ravi Soni, 32, who hails from UP and is a history-sheeter as a theft case is registered against him in Pune.Both were presently residing in Chikhali, Pune district.On September 2, the temple trustee Deepak Bodarde, 68, lodged a complaint of theft of silver Padukas from the temple.When the CCTV footage of the temple premises was checked, it was seen that a masked man wearing a hat and attired in white Kurta-Payjama entering the temple around 7.30am.He goes to the first floor of the temple where the silver Padukas were kept in front of the idol of Shree Swami Samarth.By pretending to offer prayers, he picked up the Padukas and hid them inside his Kurta and exited the temple.Inspector Rayannavar said," The theft was committed when the temple priest had gone to his room near the temple.Upon checking the CCTV footage of the roads near the temple, it was seen that two masked men on a bike were loitering near the temple and conducted a reece before committing the theft.""Considering the religious sentiments of the devotees, Raigad SP forms a special police team to detect the case at the earliest. Subsequently, the CCTV footage along the escape route of the thieves were scanned. The bike used in the crime did not have a registration number plate," Rayannavar added.He further said, "However, using technical expertise, intelligence inputs and footages of CCTV camera along the highways, the thieves on bike were tracked and apprehended from Chikhali in Pune district. We have seized from them the stolen Padukas and the bike used in the crime. On Monday, the acccused were produced before the Khalapur JMFC court that remanded them to police custody till Friday."
Article Summary: A pair of silver toe-knob sandals (Charan Paduka) representing divine footprints offered at Shree Swami Samarth temple in Khalapur city were stolen on September 2. The accused thief and his aide were arrested by tracking them to Pune on Monday.

Article Title: Cop dies by suicide at Navi Mumbai lodge, names ex-DCP, ACP and head clerk in note alleging harassment
Article Text:
The deceased identified as Pandurang Nimba Patil, a resident of Airoli.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 55-year-old Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) with the Navi Mumbai Police allegedly died by suicide at a lodge in Airoli on Saturday evening.The deceased, identified as Pandurang Nimba Patil, a resident of Airoli, had recorded a video before taking the drastic step and posted it on social media.In the video, he alleged that he was compelled to end his life due to harassment by a former DCP, an ACP, and a head clerk.ASI Patil also left behind a nine-page suicide note accusing former DCP (Headquarters) Sanjay Patil, ACP Girish Thakare, and administrative head clerk Jayu Ahire of driving him to take the extreme step by allegedly harassing him while assigning official duties.ACP (Rabale Division) Rahul Dhas said, "ASI Patil had checked into Sachi Lodging and Boarding on Saturday at 4.40 pm. Around 7.30 pm, when the housekeeping staff went to his room, he did not respond, and the door was locked from inside. The lodge manager opened the door with a master key and found ASI Patil hanging from a ceiling fan hook. The lodge manager informed the Rabale MIDC police. ASI Patil was rushed to NMMC Hospital in Vashi, where he was declared brought dead. Prima facie, an accidental death case will be registered at the Rabale MIDC police station."
Article Summary: Pandurang Nimba Patil, a 55-year-old Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) with the Navi Mumbai Police, allegedly died by suicide at a lodge in Airoli on Saturday evening. He recorded a video before taking the drastic step and posted it on social media. In the video, he alleged that he was compelled to end his life due to harassment by a former DCP, an ACP, and a head clerk.

NAVI MUMBAI: The Anti-Human Trafficking Unit (AHTU) of Navi Mumbai crime branch rescued a 12-year-old girl and a 26-year-old woman from a prostitution racket being carried out at a lodge in Nerul after conducting a raid by sending a decoy customer on Thursday.The police have arrested two managers of the lodge and a waiter for allegedly supplying women for prostitution to customers by providing them rooms at Kohinoor Palace Lodging and Boarding in Shiravane village, Nerul.Gajanan Kadam, AHTU senior inspector, said the rescued minor girl hails from UP and resided in Shiravane village with her cousins, who had brought her from UP after telling her parents that she would be given a job.The trap was laid after receiving a tip-off about prostitution being carried out at the lodge. A decoy customer was sent to the lodge, where he demanded a woman for sexual favours after booking a room. The accused demanded Rs 4,000 for supplying a woman.After the accused accepted the amount, the decoy customer signalled the police team waiting outside the lodge, following which they raided the premises.Inspector Kadam said, “The arrested accused are the lodge managers identified as Hridaykumar Singh and Deepak Ramrakhiani and the waiter Kuleshwar Kumar Singh.”At Nerul police station, an FIR was registered against the arrested accused by invoking BNS sections for trafficking of persons and joint criminal liability, along with the POCSO Act, which defines punishment for abetment, such as helping, encouraging or plotting any sexual crime against a child, and the Prevention of Immoral Traffic Act.On Friday, the three accused were produced before the Belapur JMFC court, which remanded them to police custody till Sept 9.
